rule: an error written to the console
expect: wrote an error to the console
why: AN ERROR WRITTEN TO THE CONSOLE, as a failed request writes one. A plain log line sits beside it and is not a finding. The rest of the screen is the decoy every printed tree carries: a date in words, an amount, a run's handle beside its name and a person's name, none of which is a finding, so a rule that grew too wide takes the count above one.
